reviews.title: Ultra light, long lasting, and durable.
reviews.comment: Why did you pick this product vs others?: I love this mouse. Ultra light weight is no joke, this thing feels like a dream. Floats real clean. I get a whole 2 weeks of battery at school assuming it was shut off every night, optional wired or wireless. 10/10 would recommend to everyone with a laptop or tower desktop
reviews.author: Kain Eliser

reviews.author: Yiset

reviews.title: Great mouse, two complaints
reviews.comment: The mouse is great. It's lightweight, the Bluetooth connection is strong and stable, and the movement and clicking are responsive. I only have 2 complaints. First, there is no way to disable the multicolor lights - sometimes it's nice to be able to find it in the dark after typing, other times I want total darkness. Second, the back button is absurdly small. The split between "forward" and "back" is about 75/25 in favor of forward. I cannot for the life of me understand why.
reviews.author: Kyle
